result.brief: 提出极简音视频自监督编码器 LeAVJEPA，用早期融合 ViT、模态 dropout 与 SIGReg 实现无塌缩跨模态对齐，冻结评测与零样本检索表现良好。
result.reason: Audio-visual self-supervised encoder with early-fusion ViT, modality dropout and SIGReg; contributes representation learning and cross-modal alignment, matching visual/video representation interests.
